0022600197.text: The Pistons are 6-2 through eight games, 1st in the Central and 3rd in the East, with a 2-1 home record and a 6-2 last ten, though they enter on a one-game losing streak. The Lakers are 8-2 through 10 games, 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West, and have won four straight with a 5-1 home record. Detroit will be without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), both listed as out, and the teams have not yet met in 2026-27, though the Pistons won the 2025-26 series 2-0 and took their most recent meeting 113-110 in Detroit on March 23, 2026.
